titles.title: Second, Out Of My Head

description: In this semiabstract composition, a tall, thin form sweeps upwards from the bottom of the canvas. The shape is narrow at its top but expands outwards near the bottom of the composition, like a tree widening as it meets the earth. At the top of the form are dark, geometric shapes that resemble clusters of leaves attached to the branches of a tree. Behind the tree-like element are white and gray lines that ripple beneath rectangular bands of gray, echoing the patterns of undulating waves beneath a glowing sky.
